columns.npe_end_per_face: mean hits per END face per event, from scan_end_vikuiti (raw count/2)
columns.npe_top_mean: mean total TOP hits per event, all 20 SiPMs pooled (scan_end_vik_sparse_top_v2)
columns.npe_top_median: median total TOP hits per event
columns.npe_top_iqr_sigma: IQR-based sigma of total TOP hits per event
columns.d_nearest: distance from x to nearest TOP SiPM center [mm]
columns.d_second: distance from x to second-nearest TOP SiPM center [mm]
columns.npe_end_hybrid: mean hits per END face per event from hybrid scan (scan_end_vik_sparse_top_v2, N_TOP=20)
columns.npe_end_endonly: same as npe_end_per_face — mean hits per END face per event from END-only scan
columns.delta_pe: npe_end_hybrid - npe_end_endonly [hits/face/event]: effect of TOP SiPMs on END count
